desc:
💥 RAGDOLL AWAKENING 💥
Transform into monsters and destroy a city full of ragdolls!

⚡ TRANSFORM
Become the Green Brute, swing a lightning katana, fly with laser eyes or raise a zombie army. Unlock giant monsters like the Kaiju and Kaiju Dragon!

🦴 REAL RAGDOLL PHYSICS
Every NPC reacts to every hit: they stumble, bleed, break bones, crawl away and lose limbs. Grab them, drag them and throw them!

🚗 DRIVE & DESTROY
Hop in your street car, run people over and smash lamp posts, benches and bus stops!

🚨 WANTED SYSTEM
Cause chaos and police cars, fire trucks and ambulances race in to stop you!

🧪 SANDBOX MODE
Spawn NPCs, props, meteors, tornadoes, black holes and more.

🎁 Daily rewards, a lucky wheel and new forms to unlock with kills!

🎮 Solo game: the whole city is yours.
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for more updates!
